assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-viewport background image for a calm dark navy mahjong study web app, desktop and phone adaptive cover.
Primary request: create a sophisticated quiet abstract background for the Cool theme. A deep midnight navy field with broad translucent icy-blue planes and very soft flowing bands of cyan light, a sense of clean spacious depth and polished frosted glass. No literal objects.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 1536 by 1024. Full-bleed artwork, carefully balanced when cropped to a narrow central portrait. The central 65 percent should remain very dark, low-detail and evenly quiet to support light UI text and cards. Subtle layers and blue glow mostly near outer edges and corners. Gentle broad shapes rather than narrow bright lines. No distinct focal object.
Lighting/mood: calm, precise, cool, meditative; restrained soft atmospheric illumination, not neon spectacle.
Color palette: dominant near-black navy #0b1118 and #0f1822, modest desaturated steel blue #23384b, tiny soft cyan #4cc9f0 accents at edges. Overall dark.
Materials/textures: smooth fine-grained frosted translucency, painterly smooth tonal depth, no visible noise pattern.
Constraints: one original standalone background image; no text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, UI, borders, mahjong tiles, tile faces, characters, figures, stars, icons, or busy details. Not a collage, no panels, no framed mockup. Opaque background.

Materials/textures: finely smooth frosted translucent layers and gentle atmospheric gradients.
Constraints: one original standalone background image; no text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, UI, borders, mahjong tiles, tile faces, characters, figures, icons, stars or busy details. Not a collage, no panels, no mockup. Opaque background.
